```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(irr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

if (!exists("params")) params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("analyze_repeated_inference.qmd")$params  # chunks run interactively

# Resolve the data folder; stop here rather than render an empty report
data_dir <- if (nzchar(params$data_dir)) params$data_dir else
  tail(sort(Sys.glob("../inference_results/repeated_run_*")), 1)
if (length(data_dir) == 0 || !dir.exists(file.path(data_dir, "run_1")))
  stop("No repeated-run data found (expected <data_dir>/run_1, run_2, run_3). ",
       "Set data_dir in the YAML header, or render with -P data_dir:/path/to/repeated_run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS",
       call. = FALSE)
```

# Introduction

This report analyzes the stability of model predictions across **3 repeated inference runs**. The goal is to verify if the models produce deterministic results given the same input weights and data.

**Target Directory:** `r normalizePath(data_dir, winslash = "/")`

## Methodology

- **Performance Stability**: QWK vs Ground Truth for each run.
- **Intra-Run Consistency**: Pairwise QWK between predictions of different runs.
- **Probability Drift**: Analysis of variance in the soft-max probability outputs.
- **Ensemble Model**: Averaging probabilities of ResNet50, EfficientNet-B3, and ConvNeXt-Tiny.

```{r helpers}
#| code-summary: "Helper Functions"

# Calculate Quadratic Weighted Kappa
calc_qwk <- function(rater1, rater2) {
  levels <- 1:5
  raters <- data.frame(
    R1 = factor(rater1, levels = levels),
    R2 = factor(rater2, levels = levels)
  )
  raters <- na.omit(raters)
  if(nrow(raters) == 0) return(NA)
  kappa_res <- kappa2(raters, weight = "squared")
  return(kappa_res$value)
}

# Find prediction file
find_prediction_file <- function(base, run_num, model_name) {
  run_path <- file.path(base, paste0("run_", run_num))
  files <- list.files(run_path, pattern = "predictions.csv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  model_files <- files[grep(paste0("/", model_name, "/"), files)]
  if (length(model_files) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(model_files[1])
}

# Load and Merge Data for 3 Runs
load_model_data <- function(model_name, data_dir) {
  run_data <- list()
  runs <- 1:3
  for (r in runs) {
    fpath <- find_prediction_file(data_dir, r, model_name)
    if (is.null(fpath) || !file.exists(fpath)) {
      cat(paste0("**Warning**: File not found for Run ", r, "\n"))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Read CSV
    df <- read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Check if we have the new 'original_index' column
    has_index <- "original_index" %in% colnames(df)
    
    if (has_index) {
      df <- df %>% select(original_index, filename, root_dir, true_pai, predicted_pai, starts_with("prob_pai"))
    } else {
      # Fallback for old files (though strongly recommend running inference again)
      # (original_index = row number, placed first so only the per-run columns are renamed below)
      df <- df %>% mutate(original_index = row_number()) %>%
        select(original_index, filename, root_dir, true_pai, predicted_pai, starts_with("prob_pai"))
    }
    
    # Rename columns that vary per run
    colnames(df)[5:ncol(df)] <- paste0(colnames(df)[5:ncol(df)], "_r", r)
    run_data[[r]] <- df
  }
  
  if (is.null(run_data[[1]]) || is.null(run_data[[2]]) || is.null(run_data[[3]])) return(NULL)
  
  # Join on original_index (primary) AND filename (safety check)
  # This guarantees we are matching the exact same row from the test set
  full_df <- run_data[[1]] %>%
    inner_join(run_data[[2]], by = c("original_index", "filename", "root_dir", "true_pai")) %>%
    inner_join(run_data[[3]], by = c("original_index", "filename", "root_dir", "true_pai"))
    
  return(full_df)
}

# Generic Analysis Function for displaying results
analyze_dataframe <- function(df, title_prefix="") {
  
  # 1. Performance Stability
  qwk1 <- calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r1)
  qwk2 <- calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r2)
  qwk3 <- calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r3)
  
  perf_df <- data.frame(
    Run = c("Run 1", "Run 2", "Run 3"),
    QWK_Performance = c(qwk1, qwk2, qwk3)
  )
  print(kable(perf_df, digits = 4, caption = paste(title_prefix, "- Performance Stability")) %>% 
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE))
  
  # 2. Intra-Run Consistency
  rep_1v2 <- calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r1, df$predicted_pai_r2)
  rep_2v3 <- calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r2, df$predicted_pai_r3)
  rep_1v3 <- calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r1, df$predicted_pai_r3)
  mean_intra <- mean(c(rep_1v2, rep_2v3, rep_1v3))
  
  rep_df <- data.frame(
    Comparison = c("Run 1 vs 2", "Run 2 vs 3", "Run 1 vs 3", "MEAN Intra-Run"),
    QWK = c(rep_1v2, rep_2v3, rep_1v3, mean_intra)
  )
  print(kable(rep_df, digits = 4, caption = paste(title_prefix, "- Intra-Run Consistency")) %>% 
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(4, bold = TRUE, background = "#f0f8ff"))

  # 3. Probability Drift
  # Select ONLY probability columns
  prob_cols_r1 <- df %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_")) %>% select(ends_with("_r1"))
  prob_cols_r2 <- df %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_")) %>% select(ends_with("_r2"))
  prob_cols_r3 <- df %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_")) %>% select(ends_with("_r3"))
  
  # Calculate absolute differences matrices
  p_diff_1_2 <- abs(as.matrix(prob_cols_r1) - as.matrix(prob_cols_r2))
  p_diff_2_3 <- abs(as.matrix(prob_cols_r2) - as.matrix(prob_cols_r3))
  p_diff_1_3 <- abs(as.matrix(prob_cols_r1) - as.matrix(prob_cols_r3))
  
  # Global Stats
  all_diffs <- c(p_diff_1_2, p_diff_2_3, p_diff_1_3)
  max_diff <- max(all_diffs)
  mean_diff <- mean(all_diffs)
  
  # Granular Drift Analysis
  n_total <- length(all_diffs)
  n_exact_zero <- sum(all_diffs == 0)
  n_near_zero <- sum(all_diffs > 0 & all_diffs < 1e-6)
  n_significant <- sum(all_diffs >= 1e-6)
  
  identical_preds <- with(df, predicted_pai_r1 == predicted_pai_r2 & predicted_pai_r2 == predicted_pai_r3)
  pct_id <- mean(identical_preds) * 100
  
  drift_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Identical Predictions", 
               "Max Prob Diff", 
               "Mean Prob Diff",
               "Exact Match (Diff = 0)", 
               "Small Var (0 < Diff < 1e-6)", 
               "Significant (Diff >= 1e-6)"),
    Value = c(paste0(round(pct_id, 2), "%"), 
              format(max_diff, scientific=TRUE, digits=4), 
              format(mean_diff, scientific=TRUE, digits=4),
              paste0(round(100 * n_exact_zero / n_total, 4), "%"),
              paste0(round(100 * n_near_zero / n_total, 4), "%"),
              paste0(round(100 * n_significant / n_total, 4), "%"))
  )
  print(kable(drift_df, caption = paste(title_prefix, "- Probability Drift Analysis")) %>% 
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE))
}
```

# Analysis Results

::: panel-tabset
## ResNet50

```{r run_resnet, results='asis'}
model_name <- "resnet50"
df_rn <- load_model_data(model_name, data_dir)
if(is.null(df_rn)) {
  cat("**Error**: Could not load data for ResNet50.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Loaded ", nrow(df_rn), " matched samples."))
  analyze_dataframe(df_rn, "ResNet50")
}
```

## Ensemble Model

```{r run_ensemble, results='asis'}
# Check if individual models are loaded
if(exists("df_rn") && !is.null(df_rn) && 
   exists("df_eff") && !is.null(df_eff) && 
   exists("df_conv") && !is.null(df_conv)) {
   
   cat("Calculating Ensemble (Average Probability) across models for each run...\n")
   
   # Create Ensemble Dataframe structure (start with copy of ResNet)
   df_ens <- df_rn %>% select(original_index, filename, root_dir, true_pai)
   
   # Loop through runs to calculate ensemble probabilities and predictions
   for(r in 1:3) {
      # Extract prob matrices for this run
      # Note: columns are named prob_pai_1_r1, prob_pai_2_r1, etc.
      
      cols_rn <- df_rn %>% select(ends_with(paste0("_r", r))) %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_"))
      cols_eff <- df_eff %>% select(ends_with(paste0("_r", r))) %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_"))
      cols_conv <- df_conv %>% select(ends_with(paste0("_r", r))) %>% select(starts_with("prob_pai_"))
      
      # Average probabilities
      avg_probs <- (as.matrix(cols_rn) + as.matrix(cols_eff) + as.matrix(cols_conv)) / 3
      colnames(avg_probs) <- colnames(cols_rn) # Keep column names
      
      # Determine Max Probability Class (1-5)
      pred_class <- max.col(avg_probs, ties.method = "first")   # default "random" would add fake instability
      
      # Add to Ensemble DF
      df_ens[[paste0("predicted_pai_r", r)]] <- pred_class
      df_ens <- cbind(df_ens, avg_probs)
   }
   
   # Run Standard Analysis on Ensemble DF
   analyze_dataframe(df_ens, "Ensemble Model")
   
} else {
   cat("**Error**: Cannot calculate ensemble. Ensure all 3 individual models loaded successfully.")
}
```
:::

# Summary Report

```{r summary_text, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if(exists("df_rn") && exists("df_eff") && exists("df_conv") && exists("df_ens")) {
  
  # Function to get mean QWK perf
  get_perf <- function(df) {
    mean(c(calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r1),
           calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r2),
           calc_qwk(df$true_pai, df$predicted_pai_r3)))
  }
  
  # Function to get reproducibility
  get_repro <- function(df) {
    mean(c(calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r1, df$predicted_pai_r2),
           calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r2, df$predicted_pai_r3),
           calc_qwk(df$predicted_pai_r1, df$predicted_pai_r3)))
  }

  perf_rn <- get_perf(df_rn)
  perf_eff <- get_perf(df_eff)
  perf_conv <- get_perf(df_conv)
  perf_ens <- get_perf(df_ens)
  
  repro_rn <- get_repro(df_rn)
  repro_eff <- get_repro(df_eff)
  repro_conv <- get_repro(df_conv)
  repro_ens <- get_repro(df_ens)

  cat("```text\n")
  cat("================================================================================\n")
  cat("                       PAI MODEL STABILITY ANALYSIS SUMMARY                     \n")
  cat("================================================================================\n\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("Date: %s\n", Sys.Date()))
  cat(sprintf("Number of Repeated Runs: 3\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Dataset Size: %d images\n\n", nrow(df_rn)))
  
  cat("PERFORMANCE SUMMARY (Mean QWK vs Ground Truth):\n")
  cat("-----------------------------------------------\n")
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "ResNet50", perf_rn))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "EfficientNet-B3", perf_eff))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "ConvNeXt-Tiny", perf_conv))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f (Ensemble)\n\n", "Ensemble Model", perf_ens))
  
  cat("STABILITY SUMMARY (Mean Intra-Run Reproducibility QWK):\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "ResNet50", repro_rn))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "EfficientNet-B3", repro_eff))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f\n", "ConvNeXt-Tiny", repro_conv))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %.4f (Ensemble)\n\n", "Ensemble Model", repro_ens))
  
  # Conclusion computed from the results, not a fixed statement
  same_pred <- function(df) mean(df$predicted_pai_r1 == df$predicted_pai_r2 & df$predicted_pai_r2 == df$predicted_pai_r3)
  max_drift <- function(df) {
    p <- function(r) as.matrix(select(df, starts_with("prob_pai_") & ends_with(paste0("_r", r))))
    max(abs(p(1) - p(2)), abs(p(2) - p(3)), abs(p(1) - p(3)))
  }
  all_df <- list(ResNet50 = df_rn, `EfficientNet-B3` = df_eff, `ConvNeXt-Tiny` = df_conv, Ensemble = df_ens)
  same   <- sapply(all_df, same_pred)
  perf   <- c(ResNet50 = perf_rn, `EfficientNet-B3` = perf_eff, `ConvNeXt-Tiny` = perf_conv)

  cat("CONCLUSION (computed from the results above):\n")
  if (all(same == 1)) {
    cat(sprintf("Predicted PAI identical in all 3 runs for every model; largest probability difference %.2g.\n",
                max(sapply(all_df, max_drift))))
  } else {
    changed <- same[same < 1]
    cat("Predicted PAI changed between runs for:",
        paste(sprintf("%s (%.2f%% of images)", names(changed), 100 * (1 - changed)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  cat(sprintf("Ensemble mean QWK %.4f vs best single model (%s) %.4f.\n", perf_ens, names(which.max(perf)), max(perf)))
  cat("================================================================================\n")
  cat("```\n")
}
```
